description: Use this at the very START of a hackathon build — BEFORE idea-forge — to gather the event's full, accurate documentation ecosystem into one committed resource pack: rules, published judging criteria and weights, every track/bounty, each sponsor's SDK/protocol docs (with testnet package/contract addresses and entry points), prize structure, and prior winners/showcases. idea-forge then diverges and converges on REAL extracted sources instead of guesses, and the architect plans against accurate integration facts. Trigger it when the user says "extract the hackathon docs", "gather resources for <event>", "pull the rules/tracks/sponsor docs", "research this hackathon", or hands a hackathon URL and wants the source material collected before ideating. **Many hackathon and sponsor sites are JS-heavy single-page apps (Dorahacks, Devfolio, ETHGlobal, Notion/GitBook handbooks, Docusaurus SDK docs) — this skill drives the Chrome browser tools to render, reveal, and capture that content.** As the campaign's first pipeline session it also runs the requirements TOLLGATE first (Stage 0): probe every access/plugin/MCP/toolchain the planned steps need — "check the requirements", "run the tollgate" — and commit the report so nothing is missing mid-execution. Do NOT use it to pick an idea (that's idea-forge) or to plan a build (architect).
